title: Helwit Cola Nicotine Pouches 7mg / pouch
description: Helwit Cola Nicotine Pouches capture the classic taste of cola soda in a discreet, tobacco-free format. The flavour is sweet with gentle spiced notes, offering a nostalgic soft-drink-inspired profile that's easy-going and instantly recognisable. Each pouch delivers 7mg of nicotine and is crafted from soft, plant-based fibres for all-day comfort under the lip. With no smoke, vapour or odour, Helwit pouches offer a clean, portable way to enjoy nicotine wherever you are. Made in Sweden using climate-compensated production, this pouch combines a timeless flavour with a fresh, modern format ideal for everyday use. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
